subject: IP masking
description:
I’m trying to find a static IP service to use with my mailing list. I am the victim of violent crime, and I do not want my “naked” IP going out to the thousands of people on my mailing list. Lately, it’s become much harder to find an IP masker/anonymizer/proxy that will work with my mailing list. I keep getting error messages, and the email will not go through. The latest error message I keep getting while using Mask My IP is:

Invalid URL
The requested URL could not be retrieved

The following error was encountered:

CONNECT FAIL

The Barrier Group Council Bluffs Community Schools is currently testing a new web filter. If you feel that this site should not be blocked, Please fill out this google form: Site Report Form

———

Who the heck is the Barrier Group, and why do they have control over my mailing list and email service?

Will your service provide me with what I need? I don’t understand the techie language on your website. I simply want a proxy/anonymizer that will work with my mailing list (I use Bravenet.com). The support at Bravenet suggests I use a “static IP.” I don’t want to pay for anything until I know it will work, and I don’t want to get something that is difficult to figure out/configure.

Thank you.

subject: Active Directory access
description:
Hi there,

We are running a Heroku app and are looking to fix our IP. We need to access clients' Active Directories hosted on their Email Exchange, meaning they need to whitelist our IP so their firewalls don't block our request. We are using the NET::LDAP library to access the Active Directory and I was wondering whether QuotaGuard Static will work in this instance? If so, should we be using the SOCKS proxy?

Thanks,
Ed
